assignment_policy: Review capabilities are stable. Human or digital role assignment is tenant configuration and may change without changing architecture.

reviews.name: Business Value Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm expected outcome and measurable value.

reviews.name: Architecture Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm boundaries, reuse, coupling, scalability and technical-debt impact.

reviews.name: Security Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm threats, access control and secure defaults.

reviews.name: Privacy Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm purpose limitation, data minimisation, retention and consent requirements.

reviews.name: Legal and Compliance Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm applicable legal and regulatory obligations.

reviews.name: Behaviour Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm complete expected and forbidden behaviour chains.

reviews.name: Evidence Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm claims and decisions are supported by resolvable evidence.

reviews.name: Audit Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm material actions and decisions are traceable.

reviews.name: Human Control Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm consequential decisions remain under explicit human control.

reviews.name: AI Output Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm AI output is fit for purpose, grounded and confidence-qualified.

reviews.name: Execution Safety Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm approved actions are bounded, idempotent and recoverable.

reviews.name: Deployment Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm the deployed build matches the approved release.

reviews.name: Learning Quality Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm learning is based on measured and verified outcomes.

reviews.name: Experience Quality Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm journeys are coherent, complete and understandable.

reviews.name: Accessibility Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm experience accessibility requirements are met.

reviews.name: Configuration Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm configuration is valid, versioned and isolated.

reviews.name: Integration Contract Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm adapters satisfy canonical contracts and failure policies.

reviews.name: Operational Readiness Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm monitoring, diagnostics and recovery evidence exist.

reviews.name: Release Validation
reviews.purpose: Confirm all mandatory capability gates and artefacts pass.
